regimeOutlook.action: BEARISH EUR / BULLISH USD (Sovereign Carry & Macro Divergence)
regimeOutlook.executiveThesis: Multi-week macro vector firmly favors USD over EUR. Widening 2-year sovereign yield spreads (+0.84%), a +1.38% policy rate buffer, and elevated US real yields (TIPS: 2.63%) continue to attract cross-border capital. News sentiment and central bank communications reinforce a higher-for-longer Fed policy regime relative to the ECB.
regimeOutlook.macroPillarSummary: Sovereign 2Y spread is at +0.84% (US: 4.06% vs DE: 3.22%), with central bank policy spread at +1.38% (EFFR: 3.88% vs ECB DFR: 2.50%). US 10Y TIPS real yield stands at 2.63% while European energy burden (Dutch TTF: €73.9/MWh) maintains structural terms-of-trade drag on EUR.
regimeOutlook.positioningPillarSummary: CFTC Euro FX Non-Commercial positioning is at the 18% 52-week percentile (EXTREME SHORT). 4-week net flow delta is +9,359 contracts (Aggressive Short-Covering).
regimeOutlook.newsPillarSummary: Live institutional news sentiment is USD_BULLISH (Score: -83.1). Catalyst calendar: 11 high/medium impact events tracked. Tier-1 Event Risk Guard: NORMAL.
thesisConfirmationTriggers: US-DE 2Y sovereign yield spread expanding above +90 bps
Fed speakers maintaining restrictive bias while ECB signals growth concerns
thesisInvalidationTriggers: US 2Y yield collapsing faster than German Bunds (spread tightening < +50 bps)
US Core CPI or NFP materially missing consensus to the downside
Sustained daily close above 20-day swing resistance (1.1654)
regimeOutlook.tacticalPlaybook: Maintain a multi-week bearish bias on EUR/USD. Use structural rallies toward 5-day resistance (1.1495) for optimal location rather than chasing moves at range lows. Macro invalidation sits outside 20-day high (1.1654).
